sections.title: Governance and Risk Alignment
sections.description: Cross-functional governance updates require weekly alignment across operations, analytics, legal, and customer support to keep dependencies synchronized and avoid policy drift during phased rollout.

sections.title: Execution and Stabilization
sections.description: Execution stability depends on coordinated release windows, predictable data refresh cycles, and rapid issue triage ownership so operational teams can maintain service levels during high-variance demand periods.
